kegOnlyHint: This package is not linked into Homebrew’s default command path. Follow the package instructions to configure your shell if needed.

nativeJsonHint: The original Homebrew record, including all platform variations and unrecognized fields.
bottleHelp: Bottles are precompiled Homebrew packages for the listed targets. Missing bottles do not necessarily mean a platform is unsupported.
headHelp: The latest development code, not a stable release. It may be unstable.
revisionHelp: The Homebrew packaging revision for the same upstream software version.
rosettaHelp: Apple’s compatibility tool for running Intel applications on Apple Silicon Macs.
kegOnlyHelp: Also called keg-only. Installed commands are not automatically linked into Homebrew’s default command path.
updatedHelp: The last Git commit updating this package in this Tap, not the upstream release date.
binaryHelp: Platform-specific download names indicate available binaries, not compatibility with every system version. Missing downloads do not mean a platform is unsupported.
statisticsHelp: Anonymous Homebrew installation events, not file downloads or unique users. The rolling 30/90/365-day windows overlap and cannot be added together; they are not a historical trend. The headline shows the longest available window.
serviceConfigurationHelp: These paths come from the Homebrew export environment and may differ on your computer. Use brew services to manage the service instead of copying these paths.
